description: What the order still needs before it can be placed: lines, totals in the storefront currency, the address snapshot or the shopper's saved addresses, shipping methods with prices, the payment methods this order may use, and next. With a confirmed email (path A) every method is offered, bank transfer included; before confirmation (path B) the shopper pays first with card, iDEAL or Bancontact. While a payment is open the order is not editable: check_payment shows it, cancel_payment stops it. Needs the order reference from start_order (Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or the ref argument).

ref.description: Order reference (mo1_…) from start_order, only when the client cannot send it as Authorization: Bearer
